articles.title: US voters push back on data centers, and Korean power equipment makers feel the risk
articles.easyKo: 미국 주민들이 새 데이터센터를 막으려는 움직임이 커지고 있어요. 그동안 AI 건설 붐을 믿고 주문을 쌓아 온 한국 전력기기 회사들에게는 앞으로의 주문이 줄 수 있다는 걱정거리예요. 아직 주문이 늦어졌다는 연락은 없어요.

paragraphs.en: Voters in the United States are pushing back against new data centers. That is a worry for South Korean companies that sell power equipment. Across 10 US states, 28 of 41 local ballot measures on data centers proposed limits, according to Ballotpedia. The limits ranged from construction bans and pauses to tougher rules. Locals worry about electricity costs, water use, noise and emissions from emergency generators. A Gallup survey in May found that about 70 percent of Americans oppose building AI data centers in their communities.
paragraphs.ko: 미국에서 데이터센터 반대 목소리가 커졌고, 한국 전력기기 회사들에게 걱정이 되고 있어요.

sents.en: Voters in the United States are pushing back against new data centers.
sents.ko: 미국 유권자들이 새 데이터센터에 반대하고 있어요.

sents.en: That is a worry for South Korean companies that sell power equipment.
sents.ko: 이것은 전력 설비를 파는 한국 회사들에게 걱정거리예요.

sents.en: Across 10 US states, 28 of 41 local ballot measures on data centers proposed limits, according to Ballotpedia.
sents.ko: 10개 주에서 데이터센터 관련 지역 투표안 41건 가운데 28건이 제한을 담고 있었어요.

sents.en: The limits ranged from construction bans and pauses to tougher rules.
sents.ko: 제한은 건설 금지와 일시 중단부터 더 엄한 규칙까지 다양했어요.

sents.en: Locals worry about electricity costs, water use, noise and emissions from emergency generators.
sents.ko: 주민들은 전기 요금, 물 사용, 소음, 비상 발전기의 배기가스를 걱정해요.

sents.en: A Gallup survey in May found that about 70 percent of Americans oppose building AI data centers in their communities.
sents.ko: 5월 갤럽 조사에서는 미국인의 약 70%가 자기 동네에 AI 데이터센터를 짓는 데 반대했어요.

paragraphs.en: Korean makers have been counting on the AI building boom. HD Hyundai Electric, Hyosung Heavy Industries and LS Electric have order backlogs worth about 37.9 trillion won ($27.9 billion) combined. Hyosung Heavy Industries benefits the most because it makes ultrahigh-voltage transformers and circuit breakers. At the end of the third quarter, its heavy industry division held a record backlog of 18.9 trillion won. North America made up 60 percent of it.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 회사들은 AI 붐을 믿고 주문을 많이 쌓아 왔어요.

sents.en: Korean makers have been counting on the AI building boom.
sents.ko: 한국 제조사들은 AI 건설 붐을 믿고 있었어요.

sents.en: HD Hyundai Electric, Hyosung Heavy Industries and LS Electric have order backlogs worth about 37.9 trillion won ($27.9 billion) combined.
sents.ko: HD현대일렉트릭, 효성중공업, LS일렉트릭의 쌓인 주문을 합치면 약 37조 9천억 원(279억 달러)이에요.

sents.en: Hyosung Heavy Industries benefits the most because it makes ultrahigh-voltage transformers and circuit breakers.
sents.ko: 효성중공업은 초고압 변압기와 차단기를 만들기 때문에 가장 큰 덕을 봐요.

sents.en: At the end of the third quarter, its heavy industry division held a record backlog of 18.9 trillion won.
sents.ko: 3분기 말 중공업 부문의 쌓인 주문은 사상 최대인 18조 9천억 원이었어요.

sents.en: North America made up 60 percent of it.
sents.ko: 그중 60%가 북미였어요.

paragraphs.en: An industry source told The Korea Herald that clients have not reported any order delays. Still, Tom Orlik, chief economist at Bloomberg Economics, warned that state governors may take the election results as a signal to add new limits. He said Korea and Taiwan, which gained the most from the AI boom, could be the biggest losers if momentum stalls. Orders already in the pipeline may be safe, he said, but future orders and long-term profit would suffer.
paragraphs.ko: 아직 주문 지연 연락은 없지만, 전문가는 앞으로의 주문이 줄 수 있다고 경고해요.

sents.en: An industry source told The Korea Herald that clients have not reported any order delays.
sents.ko: 한 업계 관계자는 코리아헤럴드에 고객사에서 주문 지연 연락이 없다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Still, Tom Orlik, chief economist at Bloomberg Economics, warned that state governors may take the election results as a signal to add new limits.
sents.ko: 그래도 블룸버그 이코노믹스 수석 이코노미스트 톰 오를릭은 주지사들이 선거 결과를 새 제한을 만들라는 신호로 받아들일 수 있다고 경고했어요.

sents.en: He said Korea and Taiwan, which gained the most from the AI boom, could be the biggest losers if momentum stalls.
sents.ko: 그는 AI 붐으로 가장 큰 덕을 본 한국과 대만이 기세가 꺾이면 가장 큰 피해를 볼 수 있다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Orders already in the pipeline may be safe, he said, but future orders and long-term profit would suffer.
sents.ko: 이미 들어온 주문은 괜찮을 수 있지만 앞으로의 주문과 장기 이익은 타격을 받을 거라고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: Markets reacted fast. Investors fear that Democrats, who won the midterm elections, will push for stricter rules on AI data centers. The Nasdaq fell 5.52 percent on Thursday, according to SBS News. On Friday it ended up 1.1 percent, the BBC reported, which won back only part of the loss. In Seoul, the Kospi closed down about 6 percent at 5,059.69.
paragraphs.ko: 투자자들의 걱정 때문에 미국과 한국 증시가 크게 흔들렸어요.

sents.en: Markets reacted fast.
sents.ko: 시장은 빠르게 반응했어요.

sents.en: Investors fear that Democrats, who won the midterm elections, will push for stricter rules on AI data centers.
sents.ko: 투자자들은 중간선거에서 이긴 민주당이 AI 데이터센터에 더 엄한 규칙을 밀어붙일까 걱정해요.

sents.en: The Nasdaq fell 5.52 percent on Thursday, according to SBS News.
sents.ko: SBS 뉴스에 따르면 나스닥은 목요일에 5.52% 떨어졌어요.

sents.en: On Friday it ended up 1.1 percent, the BBC reported, which won back only part of the loss.
sents.ko: BBC는 금요일에 1.1% 올라 떨어진 만큼의 일부만 되찾았다고 전했어요.

sents.en: In Seoul, the Kospi closed down about 6 percent at 5,059.69.
sents.ko: 서울에서는 코스피가 약 6% 내린 5,059.69에 마감했어요.

paragraphs.en: Some experts see the fall as healthy. Pierre Baque, chief executive of Neural Concept, told the BBC it was a necessary market correction. He said the industry must show more financial discipline in how it spends on AI buildings. Russ Shaw of Tech London Advocates said the election result was a message that AI needs a rethink.
paragraphs.ko: 일부는 이번 하락을 AI 투자에 필요한 조정이라고 봐요.

sents.en: Some experts see the fall as healthy.
sents.ko: 일부 전문가는 이번 하락이 건강한 조정이라고 봐요.

sents.en: Pierre Baque, chief executive of Neural Concept, told the BBC it was a necessary market correction.
sents.ko: 뉴럴 콘셉트의 최고경영자 피에르 바케는 BBC에 이번 하락이 꼭 필요한 시장 조정이라고 말했어요.

sents.en: He said the industry must show more financial discipline in how it spends on AI buildings.
sents.ko: 그는 업계가 AI 건설에 돈을 쓰는 방식에서 재정적 절제를 더 보여야 한다고 말했어요.

sents.en: Russ Shaw of Tech London Advocates said the election result was a message that AI needs a rethink.
sents.ko: 테크 런던 어드버킷츠의 러스 쇼는 선거 결과가 AI를 다시 생각해야 한다는 메시지라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Korean firms are still expanding. HD Hyundai Electric is adding capacity at its Ulsan and Cheongju plants. Hyosung is spending $157 million on an upgrade in Memphis, and LS Electric is building a $250 million expansion in Utah. The Herald says such firms are highly vulnerable to delays in projects.
paragraphs.ko: 한국 회사들은 공장을 넓히는 중이라 사업이 늦어지면 부담이 커요.

sents.en: Korean firms are still expanding.
sents.ko: 한국 회사들은 계속 공장을 넓히고 있어요.

sents.en: HD Hyundai Electric is adding capacity at its Ulsan and Cheongju plants.
sents.ko: HD현대일렉트릭은 울산과 청주 공장의 생산 능력을 늘리고 있어요.

sents.en: Hyosung is spending $157 million on an upgrade in Memphis, and LS Electric is building a $250 million expansion in Utah.
sents.ko: 효성은 멤피스 공장 개선에 1억 5,700만 달러를 쓰고, LS일렉트릭은 유타에서 2억 5,000만 달러짜리 증설을 하고 있어요.

sents.en: The Herald says such firms are highly vulnerable to delays in projects.
sents.ko: 헤럴드는 이런 회사들이 사업 지연에 매우 약하다고 전해요.

articles.title: Why should I care if share prices fall? A simple guide after the tech sell-off
articles.easyKo: 주식을 안 해도 주가 하락이 남의 일만은 아니에요. 연금 같은 저축이 주식에 투자되고, 오래 떨어지면 회사가 비용과 일자리를 줄일 수도 있어요. 다만 전문가들은 장기 투자라면 허둥대지 말라고 해요.

paragraphs.en: Share prices of big technology firms fell sharply this week. The BBC says the fall is blamed on an expected slowdown in AI development after the US midterm elections. In Seoul, the Kospi closed down 6.02 percent at 5,059.69 on Friday, The Korea Herald reported. Samsung Electronics closed at 188,700 won, and SK hynix fell 10.44 percent.
paragraphs.ko: 기술주 주가가 크게 떨어졌고 코스피도 6% 내렸어요.

sents.en: Share prices of big technology firms fell sharply this week.
sents.ko: 큰 기술 회사들의 주가가 이번 주 크게 떨어졌어요.

sents.en: The BBC says the fall is blamed on an expected slowdown in AI development after the US midterm elections.
sents.ko: BBC는 이번 하락이 미국 중간선거 뒤 AI 개발이 느려질 것이라는 예상 때문이라고 해요.

sents.en: In Seoul, the Kospi closed down 6.02 percent at 5,059.69 on Friday, The Korea Herald reported.
sents.ko: 코리아헤럴드에 따르면 금요일 서울에서 코스피는 6.02% 내린 5,059.69에 마감했어요.

sents.en: Samsung Electronics closed at 188,700 won, and SK hynix fell 10.44 percent.
sents.ko: 삼성전자는 188,700원에 마감했고 SK하이닉스는 10.44% 떨어졌어요.

paragraphs.en: Many people think that "the markets" do not touch their lives because they do not invest. The BBC says most people probably do invest in some way. Millions of people have a pension, and pension schemes put their savings into shares. Widespread falls in share prices are usually bad news for pension savers. But experts say pensions are a long-term bet and urge people not to panic.
paragraphs.ko: 연금 저축도 주식에 투자되므로 주가 하락은 우리와도 관계가 있어요.

sents.en: Many people think that "the markets" do not touch their lives because they do not invest.
sents.ko: 많은 사람은 투자를 하지 않으니 「시장」이 내 삶과 상관없다고 생각해요.

sents.en: The BBC says most people probably do invest in some way.
sents.ko: BBC는 대부분 사람이 어떤 식으로든 투자하고 있을 것이라고 해요.

sents.en: Millions of people have a pension, and pension schemes put their savings into shares.
sents.ko: 수백만 명이 연금이 있고, 연금 기관은 그 저축을 주식에 투자해요.

sents.en: Widespread falls in share prices are usually bad news for pension savers.
sents.ko: 주가가 널리 떨어지면 보통 연금 가입자에게는 나쁜 소식이에요.

sents.en: But experts say pensions are a long-term bet and urge people not to panic.
sents.ko: 하지만 전문가들은 연금이 장기 투자라며 당황하지 말라고 해요.

paragraphs.en: Timing matters more for people close to retirement. As they get older, pension pots tend to move into safer assets such as government bonds. When stock markets fall, these bonds can do better. Higher interest rates also tend to mean better rates on annuities.
paragraphs.ko: 은퇴가 가까우면 안전한 자산으로 옮겨 충격을 줄여요.

sents.en: Timing matters more for people close to retirement.
sents.ko: 은퇴가 가까운 사람에게는 시기가 더 중요해요.

sents.en: As they get older, pension pots tend to move into safer assets such as government bonds.
sents.ko: 나이가 들수록 연금 자금은 국채 같은 더 안전한 자산으로 옮겨 가는 경향이 있어요.

sents.en: When stock markets fall, these bonds can do better.
sents.ko: 주식 시장이 떨어질 때는 이런 채권이 더 나은 성과를 낼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Higher interest rates also tend to mean better rates on annuities.
sents.ko: 금리가 높으면 연금보험 이율도 좋아지는 경향이 있어요.

paragraphs.en: Is my job at risk? If share prices fall for a long time, investors expect a firm to fix its problems. That can mean cutting costs, and therefore jobs. The BBC adds that much is unknown, because firms weigh many factors when they decide on investment and hiring.
paragraphs.ko: 주가가 오래 떨어지면 일자리에도 영향이 갈 수 있지만, 확실하지는 않아요.

sents.en: Is my job at risk?
sents.ko: 내 일자리는 위험할까요?

sents.en: If share prices fall for a long time, investors expect a firm to fix its problems.
sents.ko: 주가가 오래 떨어지면 투자자들은 회사가 문제를 고치기를 기대해요.

sents.en: That can mean cutting costs, and therefore jobs.
sents.ko: 그것은 비용을 줄이는 것, 곧 일자리를 줄이는 것을 뜻할 수 있어요.

sents.en: The BBC adds that much is unknown, because firms weigh many factors when they decide on investment and hiring.
sents.ko: BBC는 회사가 투자와 채용을 정할 때 여러 요소를 따지므로 모르는 부분이 많다고 덧붙여요.

paragraphs.en: Falls are not always bad. Lower prices can be a chance to buy, in the hope that prices recover over the long term. The BBC notes that the tech sell-off came after big rises, so long-term investors have probably still made gains. In Korea, the Kospi started the year at 4,214.17 and peaked at 9,114.55 on June 22. It is now about 55 percent of that peak.
paragraphs.ko: 큰 상승 뒤의 하락이라 장기 투자자는 아직 이익일 수 있어요.

sents.en: Falls are not always bad.
sents.ko: 하락이 늘 나쁜 것은 아니에요.

sents.en: Lower prices can be a chance to buy, in the hope that prices recover over the long term.

articles.title: England tells secondary schools to stop teaching GCSEs before Year 10
articles.easyKo: 영국 잉글랜드 정부가 중학교 1~3학년 과정에서 GCSE(졸업 시험) 공부를 미리 시키지 말라고 해요. 시험 준비보다 더 폭넓고 흥미로운 수업을 하라는 뜻이에요.

paragraphs.en: England's government says secondary schools should stop teaching GCSE courses before Year 10. The plan covers Years 7 to 9, a stage of school known as Key Stage 3. Schools will be told not to start GCSE courses early for whole year groups. The government wants teachers to focus less on exams and more on a richer, more engaging experience.

sents.en: England's government says secondary schools should stop teaching GCSE courses before Year 10.
sents.ko: 영국 잉글랜드 정부는 중등학교가 10학년 전에 GCSE 과정을 가르치는 일을 멈춰야 한다고 밝혔어요.

paragraphs.en: Two reviews found that pupils often lose interest in their early teenage years. This hurts how often they come to school and how well they do. A survey ordered by the International Baccalaureate found that exam preparation dominated Key Stage 3 in England. In that survey, 57% of teachers said exams were the biggest influence on what they teach. Persistent absence nearly doubles between Year 6 and Year 9, government data show.

articles.easyKo: 미국 연구진이 65세 이상 약 20만 명을 살펴봤어요. 용량이 센 독감 백신을 맞은 사람이 알츠하이머병에 걸릴 위험이 더 낮게 나왔어요. 다만 '원인'이 아니라 '관련'이 있다는 결과예요.

paragraphs.en: A new study links a stronger flu shot to a lower risk of Alzheimer's disease. Researchers at UTHealth Houston studied nearly 200,000 adults aged 65 and older. The standard-dose shot was linked to a 40% lower risk, while the high-dose shot was linked to a nearly 55% lower risk. They compared people who received the high-dose shot with people who received the standard dose. The work was published in the journal Neurology.

paragraphs.en: Google, Meta and TikTok have each sued California to stop a new law about children and social media. The law is meant to protect kids from addictive apps. California Attorney General Rob Bonta is the defendant in each case. The companies filed separate suits in federal courts in San Francisco, Los Angeles and San Jose.

articles.title: Korea considers extending its label-free rule from domestic bottled water to imports
articles.easyKo: 한국은 국내 생수 병에 비닐 라벨을 붙이지 못하게 했어요. 이제 정부가 수입 생수에도 같은 규칙을 적용할지 살피고 있지만 아직 정하지는 않았어요. 국내 업체는 형평성을 말해요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea is reviewing whether to extend its label-free rule to imported bottled water. The environment ministry recently met with importers to ask whether they could switch to bottles without plastic wraparound labels. The ministry called it a routine consultation and said it has not decided yet.
paragraphs.ko: 정부가 수입 생수에도 라벨 없는 규칙을 적용할지 살펴보고 있어요.

sents.en: South Korea is reviewing whether to extend its label-free rule to imported bottled water.
sents.ko: 한국은 라벨 없는 병 규칙을 수입 생수로 넓힐지 살피고 있어요.

sents.en: The environment ministry recently met with importers to ask whether they could switch to bottles without plastic wraparound labels.
sents.ko: 환경부는 최근 수입업체를 만나 비닐 라벨 없는 병으로 바꿀 수 있는지 물었어요.

sents.en: The ministry called it a routine consultation and said it has not decided yet.
sents.ko: 환경부는 정례적인 협의라며 아직 정하지 않았다고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: The rule took effect on January 1 for bottled water made in Korea. Product information that used to be printed on labels is now available through QR codes on the bottle caps. Stores can also scan the codes at checkout. Bottles sold one by one had a one-year transition period to give retailers time to adjust.
paragraphs.ko: 국내 생수는 라벨 대신 뚜껑의 QR코드로 정보를 보여 줘요.

sents.en: The rule took effect on January 1 for bottled water made in Korea.
sents.ko: 이 규칙은 1월 1일부터 국내에서 만든 생수에 적용됐어요.

sents.en: Product information that used to be printed on labels is now available through QR codes on the bottle caps.
sents.ko: 예전에 라벨에 인쇄하던 상품 정보는 이제 병뚜껑의 QR코드로 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Stores can also scan the codes at checkout.
sents.ko: 가게에서도 계산할 때 코드를 찍을 수 있어요.

sents.en: Bottles sold one by one had a one-year transition period to give retailers time to adjust.
sents.ko: 낱개로 파는 병에는 가게가 적응할 시간을 주려고 1년의 유예 기간이 있었어요.

paragraphs.en: The ministry says the rule could cut plastic waste by about 2,270 metric tons a year. That estimate is based on the roughly 5.2 billion bottles of mineral water made in Korea in 2024. It also saves consumers a step when they sort empty bottles for recycling.
paragraphs.ko: 라벨을 없애면 플라스틱 쓰레기가 줄고 분리배출도 편해져요.

sents.en: The ministry says the rule could cut plastic waste by about 2,270 metric tons a year.
sents.ko: 환경부는 이 규칙으로 플라스틱 쓰레기가 해마다 약 2,270톤 줄 수 있다고 해요.

sents.en: That estimate is based on the roughly 5.2 billion bottles of mineral water made in Korea in 2024.
sents.ko: 이 추정은 2024년 한국에서 만든 약 52억 병의 생수를 바탕으로 해요.

sents.en: It also saves consumers a step when they sort empty bottles for recycling.
sents.ko: 빈 병을 분리배출할 때 소비자의 한 단계도 줄여 줘요.

paragraphs.en: Domestic producers say the rule puts them at a disadvantage. Imported bottles can still carry labels on store shelves. Kim Do-young, president of Jeju Province Development Corp., said shoppers took longer to find its Jeju Samdasoo brand after it switched to label-free bottles. He said he supports the goal of the policy but wants the same rule for imports.
paragraphs.ko: 국내 업체는 수입품도 같은 규칙을 따라야 공평하다고 말해요.

sents.en: Domestic producers say the rule puts them at a disadvantage.
sents.ko: 국내 생산자들은 이 규칙이 자신들에게 불리하다고 말해요.

sents.en: Imported bottles can still carry labels on store shelves.
sents.ko: 수입 병은 매장 진열대에서 여전히 라벨을 달 수 있어요.

sents.en: Kim Do-young, president of Jeju Province Development Corp., said shoppers took longer to find its Jeju Samdasoo brand after it switched to label-free bottles.
sents.ko: 제주특별자치도개발공사의 김도영 사장은 제주삼다수가 라벨 없는 병으로 바뀐 뒤 소비자가 제품을 찾는 데 더 오래 걸렸다고 말했어요.

sents.en: He said he supports the goal of the policy but wants the same rule for imports.
sents.ko: 그는 정책의 목적은 지지하지만 수입품에도 같은 규칙을 적용해 달라고 말했어요.

paragraphs.en: Imports reportedly hold only a single-digit share of Korea's bottled mineral water market, The Korea Herald says. The domestic market has grown by an average of 7.6 percent a year since 2019, reaching $4.3 billion in 2024. As of September 2024, Korea had 63 bottled water makers and 107 importers.
paragraphs.ko: 수입 생수는 비중이 작지만 시장 전체는 계속 커지고 있어요.

sents.en: Imports reportedly hold only a single-digit share of Korea's bottled mineral water market, The Korea Herald says.
sents.ko: 코리아헤럴드는 수입품이 한국 생수 시장에서 한 자릿수 비중뿐이라고 전해요.

sents.en: The domestic market has grown by an average of 7.6 percent a year since 2019, reaching $4.3 billion in 2024.
sents.ko: 국내 시장은 2019년 이후 해마다 평균 7.6% 커서 2024년에는 43억 달러에 이르렀어요.

sents.en: As of September 2024, Korea had 63 bottled water makers and 107 importers.
sents.ko: 2024년 9월 기준 한국에는 생수 제조사 63곳과 수입업체 107곳이 있었어요.

paragraphs.en: The rule has limits. It does not cover products that are legally classified as mixed beverages, a category that includes some waters with added minerals. For now, imported bottles remain outside the rule, so shoppers will still see labels on them. The ministry has said it has not decided whether to apply the rule to overseas brands.
paragraphs.ko: 혼합음료와 수입 병은 아직 규칙 밖에 있어요.

sents.en: The rule has limits.
sents.ko: 이 규칙에는 한계가 있어요.

sents.en: It does not cover products that are legally classified as mixed beverages, a category that includes some waters with added minerals.
sents.ko: 법적으로 혼합음료로 분류되는 제품은 적용되지 않는데, 여기에는 미네랄을 더한 일부 물 제품도 들어 있어요.

sents.en: For now, imported bottles remain outside the rule, so shoppers will still see labels on them.
sents.ko: 지금은 수입 병이 규칙 밖에 있어서 소비자는 수입 병에서 여전히 라벨을 보게 돼요.

sents.en: The ministry has said it has not decided whether to apply the rule to overseas brands.
sents.ko: 환경부는 이 규칙을 해외 브랜드에 적용할지 아직 정하지 않았다고 밝혔어요.

articles.title: State audit says Seoul was slow to warn about job scams in Cambodia
articles.easyKo: 정부 감사원이 외교부가 캄보디아 취업 사기를 알고도 여행 경보를 제때 올리지 않았다고 밝혔어요. 높은 월급을 내건 해외 일자리 제안이 위험할 수 있다는 점을 다시 알려 주는 소식이에요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's state audit agency said on Thursday that the foreign ministry was too slow to react to job scams in Cambodia. The ministry knew the scams targeting South Koreans were getting worse, but it did not raise the travel alert in time. Last year, a Korean college student died in Cambodia after being lured there, and the case caused public outrage.
paragraphs.ko: 감사원은 외교부가 취업 사기를 알고도 늦게 대응했다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: South Korea's state audit agency said on Thursday that the foreign ministry was too slow to react to job scams in Cambodia.
sents.ko: 감사원은 목요일 외교부가 캄보디아 취업 사기에 너무 늦게 대응했다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: The ministry knew the scams targeting South Koreans were getting worse, but it did not raise the travel alert in time.
sents.ko: 외교부는 한국인을 노린 사기가 심해지는 것을 알았지만 여행 경보를 제때 올리지 않았어요.

sents.en: Last year, a Korean college student died in Cambodia after being lured there, and the case caused public outrage.
sents.ko: 지난해 한국 대학생이 캄보디아로 유인된 뒤 숨져 큰 분노를 불렀어요.

paragraphs.en: According to the Board of Audit and Inspection, the ministry learned about the problem after December 2023. It heard from embassies and private firms that young South Koreans were lured by promises of high-paying jobs. The embassy in Cambodia suggested raising the travel alert in April and July 2024. The ministry did not, saying the situation was below the criteria for a special alert.
paragraphs.ko: 대사관이 경보 상향을 건의했지만 외교부는 올리지 않았어요.

sents.en: According to the Board of Audit and Inspection, the ministry learned about the problem after December 2023.
sents.ko: 감사원에 따르면 외교부는 2023년 12월 이후 이 문제를 알게 됐어요.

sents.en: It heard from embassies and private firms that young South Koreans were lured by promises of high-paying jobs.
sents.ko: 공관과 민간 기업을 통해 한국 청년들이 높은 월급 약속에 유인된다는 이야기를 들었어요.

sents.en: The embassy in Cambodia suggested raising the travel alert in April and July 2024.
sents.ko: 주캄보디아 대사관은 2024년 4월과 7월에 여행 경보를 올리자고 건의했어요.

sents.en: The ministry did not, saying the situation was below the criteria for a special alert.
sents.ko: 외교부는 특별 경보 기준에 못 미친다는 등의 이유로 올리지 않았어요.

paragraphs.en: Only after media reports in August did the ministry move to upgrade the alert. The alert was raised in September, after the student's death became public. The audit also said the ministry should have set up a task force to protect Koreans abroad, but it did not even hold a meeting. The agency advised disciplinary measures against three ministry officials.
paragraphs.ko: 경보는 사건이 알려진 뒤에야 올랐고, 감사원은 세 명 징계를 권고했어요.

sents.en: Only after media reports in August did the ministry move to upgrade the alert.
sents.ko: 8월 언론 보도가 나온 뒤에야 외교부가 경보 상향에 나섰어요.

sents.en: The alert was raised in September, after the student's death became public.
sents.ko: 경보는 학생의 죽음이 알려진 뒤인 9월에 올랐어요.

sents.en: The audit also said the ministry should have set up a task force to protect Koreans abroad, but it did not even hold a meeting.
sents.ko: 감사원은 외교부가 해외 국민 보호 태스크포스를 꾸렸어야 했는데 회의조차 열지 않았다고 했어요.

articles.title: Kia is on track to meet its yearly sales goal for the first time in 12 years
articles.easyKo: 기아가 올해 판매 목표를 12년 만에 처음으로 채울 것으로 보여요. 10월까지 판 차가 목표의 82.7%에 이르렀고, 미국에서 하이브리드가 크게 늘었어요.

paragraphs.en: The German science and technology company Merck is investing 300 million euros ($338 million) in a new production center in Daejeon. It is Merck's largest life science investment in the Asia-Pacific region so far. The company wants to make products in the region for customers in the region.
paragraphs.ko: 머크가 대전에 약 3억 유로를 들여 새 생산 센터를 지었어요.

articles.title: After inflation, US public college tuition keeps falling, College Board says
articles.easyKo: 미국 대학위원회 보고서에 따르면 물가를 빼고 보면 공립대 등록금은 10년 사이 줄었어요. 장학금 같은 지원을 빼고 실제로 내는 돈은 더 낮아요. 하지만 집값·식비 같은 생활비는 여전히 커요.

paragraphs.en: A new College Board report says college tuition is getting cheaper at public schools in the US once inflation is counted. From 2016-17 to 2026-27, average tuition and fees fell 12% at public colleges for in-district students and 8% at public four-year universities for in-state students. At private nonprofit colleges, prices stayed flat.

sents.en: At private nonprofit colleges, prices stayed flat.
sents.ko: 사립 비영리 대학에서는 가격이 그대로였어요.

paragraphs.en: Published in-state and in-district prices at public colleges still rose less than 3% this year before inflation. The average published price at a public four-year college is $12,290 for in-state students and $32,730 for out-of-state students. About 70% of full-time undergraduates get grant aid, which lowers what they really pay. For first-time in-state students at public four-year colleges, net tuition and fees average $1,920, down from $4,600 in 2012-13.

articles.title: Strange gas leaks suggest Mars may still be volcanically active
articles.easyKo: 화성 탐사선이 큰 화산 근처에서 염화수소라는 가스를 찾았어요. 여름에 있을 리 없는 때에 나타났고, 근처에 새 갈라진 틈도 보였어요. 화성 땅속에 아직 뜨거운 마그마가 있을 수 있다는 단서예요.

paragraphs.en: Scientists found unusual amounts of hydrogen chloride gas above cracks near Alba Mons, a huge volcano on Mars. They used the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter, a spacecraft run by the European Space Agency. On Earth, this gas often comes out of openings linked to magma.
paragraphs.ko: 유럽우주국 탐사선이 화성의 큰 화산 알바 몬스 근처에서 염화수소가 많은 것을 찾았어요. 이 가스는 지구에서는 마그마와 이어진 곳에서 나와요.

sents.en: Scientists found unusual amounts of hydrogen chloride gas above cracks near Alba Mons, a huge volcano on Mars.
sents.ko: 과학자들은 화성의 거대한 화산 알바 몬스 근처 갈라진 틈 위에서 평소와 다른 양의 염화수소 가스를 찾았어요.

sents.en: They used the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter, a spacecraft run by the European Space Agency.
sents.ko: 그들은 유럽우주국이 운영하는 탐사선 '엑소마스 트레이스 가스 오비터'를 썼어요.

sents.en: On Earth, this gas often comes out of openings linked to magma.
sents.ko: 지구에서는 이 가스가 흔히 마그마와 이어진 틈에서 나와요.

paragraphs.en: Hydrogen chloride on Mars usually peaks in northern winter and falls to very low levels in summer. But in early summer it kept showing up at high levels over this area. Pictures from the orbiter showed narrow cracks that looked fresh, with color changes around them.
paragraphs.ko: 염화수소는 보통 겨울에 많고 여름에는 아주 적어져요. 그런데 이곳에서는 초여름에 거듭 높게 나왔어요.

sents.en: Hydrogen chloride on Mars usually peaks in northern winter and falls to very low levels in summer.
sents.ko: 화성의 염화수소는 보통 북반구 겨울에 가장 많고 여름에는 아주 낮아져요.

sents.en: But in early summer it kept showing up at high levels over this area.
sents.ko: 그런데 초여름에 이 지역 위에서 높은 수치가 계속 나타났어요.

sents.en: Pictures from the orbiter showed narrow cracks that looked fresh, with color changes around them.
sents.ko: 탐사선 사진에는 새로 생긴 듯한 좁은 틈과 그 주변의 색 변화가 보였어요.

paragraphs.en: The team thinks gas from hot magma underground may be escaping through the cracks. Co-lead author Daniel Mège said Mars kept enough inner heat to support volcanic activity until recently, and possibly still does. However, scientists have never directly seen a new eruption or fresh lava flow on Mars. The study was published in the journal Science Advances.
paragraphs.ko: 연구진은 땅속 마그마의 가스가 틈으로 새어 나올 수 있다고 봐요. 하지만 화성에서 새 용암이나 분화가 직접 관측된 적은 없어요.

sents.en: The team thinks gas from hot magma underground may be escaping through the cracks.
sents.ko: 연구진은 땅속 뜨거운 마그마의 가스가 틈으로 새어 나오고 있을지 모른다고 봐요.

sents.en: Co-lead author Daniel Mège said Mars kept enough inner heat to support volcanic activity until recently, and possibly still does.
sents.ko: 공동 책임 저자 다니엘 메주는 화성이 최근까지 화산 활동을 이어갈 만큼 내부 열을 간직했고 지금도 그럴 수 있다고 말했어요.

sents.en: However, scientists have never directly seen a new eruption or fresh lava flow on Mars.
sents.ko: 하지만 과학자들은 화성에서 새 분화나 새 용암 흐름을 직접 본 적이 없어요.

sents.en: The study was published in the journal Science Advances.
sents.ko: 이 연구는 학술지 '사이언스 어드밴시스'에 실렸어요.

articles.title: University of Maine offers early retirement buyouts to 158 faculty to cut its budget gap
articles.easyKo: 미국 메인 대학이 재정 부족을 줄이려고 교수 158명에게 조기 퇴직 보상금을 제안했어요. 참여하는 교수가 많을수록 해고 규모가 달라질 수 있어요.

paragraphs.en: The University of Maine is offering voluntary buyouts to 158 faculty members as it works to cut its budget. Eligible faculty are over 55 and have worked full time for at least 10 years. Those who accept will get one payment equal to their base annual salary when they retire on Sept. 1 next year.
paragraphs.ko: 메인 대학은 55세 넘고 10년 일한 교수 158명에게 조기 퇴직 보상금을 제안했어요. 퇴직하면 기본 연봉만큼 한 번에 받아요.

sents.en: The University of Maine is offering voluntary buyouts to 158 faculty members as it works to cut its budget.
sents.ko: 메인 대학은 예산을 줄이려고 교수 158명에게 자발적 퇴직 보상금을 제안하고 있어요.

sents.en: Eligible faculty are over 55 and have worked full time for at least 10 years.
sents.ko: 대상 교수는 55세가 넘고 전일제로 10년 이상 일한 사람이에요.

sents.en: Those who accept will get one payment equal to their base annual salary when they retire on Sept. 1 next year.
sents.ko: 받아들이는 교수는 내년 9월 1일 퇴직할 때 기본 연봉과 같은 돈을 한 번에 받아요.

paragraphs.en: Leaders say they face a $19 million structural gap. The faculty unions on both campuses voted to move the offer forward. How many people accept could affect how many layoffs are needed, because officials have already said job cuts are likely.

sents.ko: 학교 지도부는 1,900만 달러의 구조적 적자가 있다고 말해요.

sents.en: The faculty unions on both campuses voted to move the offer forward.
sents.ko: 두 캠퍼스의 교수 노조는 이 제안을 진행하기로 표결했어요.

sents.en: How many people accept could affect how many layoffs are needed, because officials have already said job cuts are likely.

paragraphs.en: So far the school has outlined plans to cut $10 million from its academic budget and $6 million from its nonacademic budget.
